verdict.summary: The design record is internally consistent with the current audit implementation and accurately identifies the central safety property: deriving expectations from the same record corpus makes completeness circular, while independent, all-state PR enumeration can expose missing provenance without licensing revocation. Its recommendations preserve the audit's offline/read-only boundary, require authoritative pagination and fail-closed handling, and correctly prioritize the existing split-corpus false-revocation risk. The change is documentation-only, introduces no executable trust-plane behavior, and I found no blocker or major correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue in the diff.
